verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a public REST API giving programmatic control over the entire platform, and the CLI and SDK are built on top of it. A live probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec, and an llms.txt is also served. Scoped API keys for automation, an official CLI and Python SDK on GitHub, and an agent skill all show the API can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the REST API directly.
